title: acs/cycle463 runs about 530 to 550 s against the 600 s go test default timeout
summary: The suite wraps a whole-tree vet and race run. On main it took about 533 s; under host load it hits the 600 s default timeout (seen 2026-10-26 during the review of #1131). It predates X8.
fix: Scope the wrapped run to the packages the predicate names, or give the package an explicit -timeout in the acs runner.
acceptance: go test -tags acs ./acs/cycle463/ finishes under 300 s on the console host
